svg.title: Binary search: the window halving, four rows deep
svg.desc: Four rows of the same twelve-element sorted array. In each row the eliminated half is greyed and crossed out, the midpoint is highlighted, and the invariant lo and hi plus the comparison made is written to the right, ending when the midpoint lands on 72.
svg.text: Binary search: the window halving, four rows deep
invariant: if the target is anywhere, it is inside [lo,
hi]. Every step halves that window.
the bug everyone writes: while lo <
hi vs lo <= hi, and mid = (lo+hi)//2
